projects.title: Here, there, everywhere
projects.description:
CARGOBOX is a new transport company whose services range from air, sea to road transport.Cargobox was creating its identity and asked us to create a special and attractive image that would make it enter the market very quickly and stand out from the competition.

It was a job with a lot of responsibility but very enjoyable at the same time. Everything was done from scratch.

We started by creating a very meaningful logo that relates to the company's services. In its center we placed two arrows in opposite directions that represent the coming and going, each of the arrows carry the letter "C" a…
